decisions.reason: Margin analysis draws directly on the firm's maintained tariff and market-data databases, so the firm can interpret results and refine it with its own R&D at low cost.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and uses existing data capture and calculation know-how, which fits the central platform strategy.
The regional electricity tariff calculator closely extends established competencies, and the firm has strong absorptive capacity to keep improving it.
The area definition tool uses regional and network data expertise and supports the other location-based products on the platform.
Site-specific comparison uses existing databases and know-how, but its low website visibility and overlap with B and the withdrawn D raise some risk of consolidation.
